title: Add flags to toggle fingerprint spoofing
body:
Currently, flag `--fingerprint={value}` changes these fields (according to spec):
- User-Agent
- Operating System
- Audio
- Plugins
- CPU Cores
- Memory
- WebGL Image
- WebGL Metadata
- Fonts
- Canvas Image
- Canvas Text
- ClientRects
- WebRTC
- Language Support
- Timezone Support

I think it would be very handy to add some kind of `--disable-spoofing={value1,value2,value3,....}` flag, that can intake comma-separated values.
For example, most of the time i don't want to spoof Fonts, Plugins and OS-related stuff like Operating System, CPU Cores and Memory.
Possible flag would look like:
`--disable-spoofing=fonts,plugins,operatingSystem,cpuCores,memory`

You already have `--disable-gpu-fingerprint` flag, but i think it would be cleaner to have a list-supporting flag.
Point is: spoofing is good, but to a certain point. Unrealistic Fonts, CPU and memory configs actually makes more harm - sites flag that as unrecognisable PC setup.
